Definition: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
BiblicalUsage: 1) emptiness, vanity, falsehood; 1a) emptiness, nothingness, vanity; 1b) emptiness of speech, lying; 1c) worthlessness (of conduct)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
